title: nixos.prefect: module fixes
structural_notes: Diff touches three existing mkOption declaration blocks: dataDir (description text rewritten, type/default unchanged), databasePasswordFile (example added, description rewritten), and baseUrl (type changed nullOr str -> str, default changed null -> "http://${localHost}:${toString cfg.port}", defaultText/example/description changed). Watched: baseline enable + dataDir + databasePasswordFile + baseUrl. Not watched (diff does not touch their mkOption declaration lines, only their usages/call-sites inside serviceConfig blocks that were refactored into a shared `hardening` attrset and `postgresEnvironment`/`localHost` let-bindings): host, port, database, databaseHost, databasePort, databaseName, databaseUser, workerPools.<name>.installPolicy -- noted here structurally but excluded per the stated diff-touch rule. Test file also changed substantially: base test's single 'machine' node set baseUrl="http://127.0.0.1" and no workerPools; head test's 'machine' node sets workerPools.default.installPolicy="never" (no baseUrl) and adds a new 'postgres' node with database=postgres, databaseUser=prefect, databasePasswordFile=/etc/prefect-db-password.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: databasePasswordFile transitions from OBA001 (base, predicate witnessed:false) to PASS (head, predicate witnessed:true via the new postgres test node). This shows up in raw.json's oba_verdict_transitions/resolved_findings but NOT in summary.notable (notable_total=0), so it is reported here only as a raw fact, not counted as an actionable presentation per the task's notable-array-only definition. dataDir and baseUrl both show PredicateNotFound on both sides (no mkIf/predicate site referencing them was found by the tool), so neither is a PASS-on-both-sides case.
